shadowSentences: I love to read books on weekends.
My favorite season is autumn with the changing leaves.
I often cook dinner for my family in the evenings.
Traveling to new cities always excites me.
I enjoy hiking in the mountains during my free time.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I usually spend time with friends at local cafes and parks.
Gardening is a rewarding hobby that I started last year.
Finding new recipes online has made cooking more fun for me.
Attending cultural festivals in my city has broadened my perspectives.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: How do you feel traveling impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever faced difficulties in maintaining a routine?
Q3: Why do you think regular exercise is important for health?
Q4: How would you encourage someone to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study techniques.
questions: Q1: What study methods have worked best for you in school?
Q2: What challenges do you encounter when studying for exams?
Q3: In your opinion, how can effective study habits impact grades?
Q4: What tips would you give to students struggling with their studies?
